use_cases.title: Use Cases and Versatility
use_cases.subtitle: A motor interface adaptable to sensitive everyday and workplace contexts.
use_cases.card_1_desc: Comforting physical presence, without emotional manipulation. Scrupulous preservation of relational boundaries through our ethical guardrails.
use_cases.card_2_desc: Ideal for deep work and neurodivergent individuals (ADHD). The robot acts as a physical anchor for focus and motivation.
use_cases.card_3_desc: Spoken and gestural interactions in a trilingual context (inclusive French, English, and Japanese with keigo nuances). Immersive, judgement-free practice.

safety.title: Safety, Ethics, and Regulation
safety.subtitle: An uncompromising commitment to responsible and transparent embodied AI.
safety.guardrails_desc: Physical embodiment multiplies the psychological impact of AI. Entrelac enforces formal boundaries at the middleware level to prevent the illusion of consciousness and emotional dependency.
safety.anti_mirror_desc: Prohibition of unconditional compliance (anti-sycophancy). Our algorithm dampens cognitive echo chambers and refuses to validate delusional spirals or harmful ideation.
safety.physical_env_desc: Continuous local verification of motor vectors. In the event of an anomaly or tipping/falling risk, the middleware forces an instant safe-stop.
safety.manifesto_desc: Auditable code, open API specifications, and proactive alignment with Canada's Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA) and NIST standards.

research.title: Expert Resources and Research
research.subtitle: Third-party, objective, academic library guiding Entrelac's foundations.
research.intro: Our engineering relies on independent scientific literature. We document real-world risks to design tangible safeguards.
research.item_1_title: Clinical studies on psychosis and AI (Hudon and Stip)
research.item_1_desc: Research by Drs. Alexandre Hudon and Emmanuel Stip highlighting the risks of psychotic exacerbation when interacting with unguarded conversational agents.
research.item_2_desc: Guidelines and leading-edge research on the robustness, alignment, and social responsibility of autonomous systems.
research.item_3_desc: Critical analyses and normative frameworks to ensure fundamental rights and human dignity take precedence over automation.

b2b_hardware.title: B2B — Robotic Hardware Manufacturers
b2b_hardware.subtitle: Bring your robotic platforms to life through our unified software layer.
b2b_hardware.criteria_intro: To integrate Entrelac middleware, your physical platform must meet the following requirements:
b2b_hardware.spec_1: Standardized local API connection (USB-C, Bluetooth LE, secure local Wi-Fi).
b2b_hardware.spec_2: Minimum kinematic refresh rate of 30 Hz for expressions and movements.
b2b_hardware.exclusion_1: No flight capability (drones or aircraft strictly excluded).
b2b_hardware.exclusion_2: Complete absence of sharp, piercing, hot, or potentially blunt-force parts.
b2b_hardware.exclusion_3: Limited weight and motor torque to prevent any risk of physical injury in a home environment.

b2b_retail.title: B2B — Physical Retail and Branches
b2b_retail.subtitle: Reception and customer-experience robots with complete local governance.
b2b_retail.feature_1_desc: Configure the tone, product knowledge, and linguistic register of your reception robot with no risk of hallucination or tone drift.
b2b_retail.feature_2_desc: No customer voices, images, or interactions are ever sent to the cloud to animate gestures. Strict compliance with Quebec's Law 25.
b2b_retail.feature_3_desc: Even during an Internet outage, physical reception, core animations, and preset directions remain 100% operational.

api_guide.title: API Guide — Plain-Language Overview
api_guide.subtitle: How to check whether an AI or language model is compatible with Entrelac
api_guide.intro: No PhD in robotics required. This simplified guide explains how your favourite models communicate with Entrelac middleware.
api_guide.step_1_desc: Does your LLM support structured outputs (JSON) or function calling (Function Calling / Tool Use)? If so, Entrelac can translate its intentions into physical kinematics.
api_guide.step_2_desc: For fluid conversation with physical expression, a time to first token (TTFT) under 500 ms is recommended when running locally (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM).
api_guide.step_3_desc: Two lines of code are all it takes to connect your API endpoint to Entrelac's local daemon. The daemon automatically handles collision avoidance and gestural pacing.

about.title: About Entrelac IA inc.
about.subtitle: At the crossroads of linguistics, human cognition, and sovereign robotics.
about.story_desc: Entrelac was born from a striking observation: generative artificial intelligence is advancing at breakneck speed on screens, yet its embodiment in the physical world remains either locked inside closed proprietary silos or dangerously naive regarding human psychological vulnerabilities.
about.founder_desc: Drawing on a unique background combining a Master of Arts (M.A.) in trilingual interpreting and communication (French, English, Japanese) with deep expertise in AI software architectures, the founder approaches human-robot interaction through the lens of semantic fidelity, cultural nuance, and ethical responsibility.
about.partners_desc: Entrelac is preparing for incubation, a research and development internship in close collaboration with academia, and integration pilot projects.
